title: Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows
summary: The Decoder 报道，Claude Artifacts 可作为 macOS 或 Windows 应用安装；功能处于 beta，需要最新版 Claude 客户端，免费账户也可使用。
investorNote: 原型转为常驻工具的摩擦降低，实际价值取决于系统权限、可靠性和维护成本。

fact.subject: Anthropic
fact.action: 推出 Artifacts 桌面安装测试

evidence.quote: The feature is in beta as of today and requires the latest version of Claude for macOS or Windows.
